description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Secunetics is an innovative company focused on making IT safer through their Gobo Framework, a FedRAMP-authorized SaaS platform. They are seeking an Entry-level Software Engineer to design and develop AI-powered solutions, APIs, and ensure code integrity while optimizing data architecture for federal agencies.
Federal AI workflow automation specialist for secure APIs and data infrastructure

Responsibilities:
• Engineer AI-Powered Solutions: Design, build, and deploy intelligent agents within the Gobo Framework to automate complex federal workflows
• Develop Robust APIs: Architect and consume secure, scalable RESTful APIs that serve as the backbone for mission-critical applications
• Ensure Code Integrity: Implement comprehensive automated unit tests and end-to-end testing frameworks to maintain high reliability in high-stakes environments
• Optimize Data Architecture: Develop and manage sophisticated data structures across relational databases and large-scale data warehouses
• Implement Security-First Development: Incorporate proactive mitigations for web application security risks directly into the software development lifecycle
• Drive Innovation: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to transform complex infrastructure requirements into elegant, automated software solutions

Requirements:
• Python
• JavaScript and/or TypeScript
• Experience developing with agentic coding tools
• Experience developing automated unit tests and end-to-end tests
• Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs
• Experience developing with relational databases and data warehouses
• Deep understanding of web application security risks and mitigations
• Experience debugging failures in a running production system using logs, traces, and metrics

Preferred:
• Experience developing applications for cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Amazon Web Services (AWS)
• Broad understanding of AI/ML technologies with the ability to identify and implement diverse, architecturally sound solutions beyond basic LLM prompting
• Exposure to networking and security concepts and technologies
• Experience with containerization (e.g., Docker) and container orchestration with Kubernetes
• An undergraduate or graduate degree in computer science or related field
